high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post featuring a visual demonstration of how paint can alter the perception of space in a room. The post is by the account "wehavethedata" and includes a track by Tainy, Skrillex, Four Tet, and Rauw Alejandro titled "VOLVER." The main content of the post is a grid of nine images showing different rooms with varying wall colors and arrangements. Each image is labeled to describe the effect of the paint on the room's appearance: Expanding the space: A light-colored wall makes the room appear larger. **Stretching
